description: This file defines the EmbedTokenParser class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for parsing 'embed' tags within templates to facilitate embedding and extending templates with embedded content.

classes.name: EmbedTokenParser
classes.description: Final class extending IncludeTokenParser, responsible for parsing 'embed' tags that allow template embedding and inheritance in Twig.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an 'embed' token, manages the extraction of the parent template, and creates an EmbedNode representing the embedded template structure.

methods.name: decideBlockEnd
methods.description: Determines if the current token indicates the end of an 'embed' block by testing for 'endembed'.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name associated with this token parser, which is 'embed'.
